title: What If You Only Drank Coffee? The Number Surprises Most People

scenes.text: What if coffee was all you drank? The danger isn't where you think.
The safe limit for a healthy adult is about 400 milligrams a day. That's roughly four home-brewed cups.
Past that, jitters, a racing heart and no sleep. Stay there and the headaches and nausea come next.
The famous lethal dose is about ten grams of caffeine. That is fifty to a hundred cups, drunk fast.
Almost nobody drinks that much, which is why a lethal dose is so hard to reach.
So the real cost of a coffee-only life isn't one big dose. It's weeks of jitters and no sleep.
